description: Comprehensive knowledge base for IT-related support questions

articles.title: How to Reset Your Password
articles.question: How do I reset my password?
articles.content:
## Password Reset Instructions

**Option 1: Self-Service Reset**
1. Go to the login page and click **"Forgot Password"**
2. Enter your email address
3. Check your inbox for a reset link (check spam folder too)
4. Click the link and create a new password

**Option 2: Contact IT**
If self-service doesn't work, create a ticket and we'll reset it for you.

**Password Requirements:**
- Minimum 8 characters
- At least one uppercase letter
- At least one number
- At least one special character

articles.title: VPN Connection Issues
articles.question: How do I fix VPN connection problems?
articles.content:
## VPN Troubleshooting

**Step 1: Check Your Internet**
- Make sure you have a stable internet connection
- Try opening a website to confirm

**Step 2: Restart VPN Client**
1. Close the VPN application completely
2. Wait 10 seconds
3. Reopen and try connecting again

**Step 3: Check Credentials**
- Ensure you're using the correct username
- Your VPN password may be different from your email password

**Step 4: Try Different Server**
- Select a different VPN server location
- Some servers may be temporarily down

**Still not working?** Create a support ticket with the error message.

articles.title: Account Locked Out
articles.question: My account is locked, what do I do?
articles.content:
## Account Lockout Resolution

**Why This Happens:**
Accounts lock after 5 failed login attempts to protect your security.

**What To Do:**
1. **Wait 15 minutes** - The account unlocks automatically
2. **Reset your password** if you've forgotten it
3. **Contact IT** if you need immediate access

**Prevention Tips:**
- Use a password manager
- Enable "Remember Me" on trusted devices
- Update saved passwords after a reset

articles.title: Printer Not Working
articles.question: My printer isn't working, how do I fix it?
articles.content:
## Printer Troubleshooting

**Quick Fixes:**
1. ✅ Check if printer is powered on
2. ✅ Check for paper jams
3. ✅ Verify paper and ink levels
4. ✅ Ensure it's connected to the network

**On Your Computer:**
1. Go to **Settings > Printers & Scanners**
2. Check if the printer shows as "Ready"
3. If "Offline", right-click and select **"Use Printer Online"**
4. Try printing a test page

**Still Not Working?**
- Try removing and re-adding the printer
- Restart your computer
- Create a ticket if the issue persists

articles.title: Email Not Syncing
articles.question: Why aren't my emails syncing?
articles.content:
## Email Sync Issues

**Outlook Desktop:**
1. Check your internet connection
2. Look at the bottom status bar - it should say "Connected"
3. Click **Send/Receive > Send/Receive All Folders**
4. If offline, click **Work Offline** to reconnect

**Outlook Web:**
1. Refresh the page (F5)
2. Clear browser cache
3. Try a different browser

**Mobile Devices:**
1. Check WiFi/data connection
2. Remove and re-add the email account
3. Ensure background sync is enabled

**If emails are missing entirely**, they may be in your Spam/Junk folder.

articles.title: Software Installation Request
articles.question: How do I request new software?
articles.content:
## Requesting Software Installation

**Self-Service Software:**
Some approved software is available in the **Company Portal** app on your computer.

**Requesting Other Software:**
1. Create a support ticket with:
   - Software name and version
   - Business justification
   - Your department
2. We'll check licensing and compatibility
3. Installation typically takes 1-3 business days

**Note:** Personal or unlicensed software cannot be installed on company devices.

articles.title: Computer Running Slow
articles.question: Why is my computer running slow?
articles.content:
## Speed Up Your Computer

**Quick Fixes:**
1. **Restart your computer** (not just sleep/hibernate)
2. **Close unused applications** - check the taskbar
3. **Check disk space** - keep at least 10GB free

**Browser Slow?**
- Close extra tabs (each uses memory)
- Clear browser cache
- Disable unused extensions

**Still Slow?**
- Press Ctrl+Shift+Esc to open Task Manager
- Check which programs use the most CPU/Memory
- End unnecessary processes

**If the problem persists, create a ticket** and we'll investigate further.

video.title: Diagnosing Slow Computers - Task Manager & More

articles.title: Two-Factor Authentication Setup
articles.question: How do I set up two-factor authentication?
articles.content:
## Setting Up 2FA/MFA

**What You'll Need:**
- Your smartphone
- Microsoft Authenticator app (or similar)

**Steps:**
1. Download **Microsoft Authenticator** from your app store
2. Login to your account settings portal
3. Go to **Security > Two-Factor Authentication**
4. Click **Set Up** and scan the QR code with the app
5. Enter the verification code to confirm

**Backup Codes:**
- Save the backup codes in a secure location
- Use these if you lose access to your phone

**Lost Your Phone?** Contact IT immediately to reset 2FA.

articles.title: Monitor Not Working
articles.question: My monitor is not displaying anything
articles.content:
## Monitor Troubleshooting

**Basic Checks:**
1. ✅ Is the monitor powered on? (Check power light)
2. ✅ Is the cable securely connected at both ends?
3. ✅ Try a different cable if available
4. ✅ Try a different port on your computer

**No Signal Message:**
1. Press **Windows + P** to open display settings
2. Select **Duplicate** or **Extend**
3. Wait a few seconds for detection

**Second Monitor Issues:**
1. Right-click desktop > **Display Settings**
2. Click **Detect** to find the monitor
3. Ensure the correct display is selected

**Still Black Screen?**
- Try connecting to a different computer
- The monitor may need service

articles.title: Keyboard or Mouse Not Working
articles.question: My keyboard or mouse isn't working
articles.content:
## Keyboard/Mouse Troubleshooting

**Wired Devices:**
1. Unplug and replug the USB cable
2. Try a different USB port
3. Restart your computer

**Wireless Devices:**
1. Check/replace the batteries
2. Ensure the USB receiver is plugged in
3. Turn the device off and on again
4. Try re-pairing with the receiver

**Bluetooth Devices:**
1. Check Bluetooth is enabled on your PC
2. Remove and re-pair the device
3. Update Bluetooth drivers

**Specific Issues:**
- **Stuck keys:** Clean under the keys
- **Cursor jumping:** Clean mouse sensor, use a mouse pad
- **Double-clicking:** Adjust click speed in mouse settings

articles.title: Laptop Battery Issues
articles.question: My laptop battery isn't charging or drains quickly
articles.content:
## Battery Troubleshooting

**Not Charging:**
1. Check the power adapter is plugged in securely
2. Try a different power outlet
3. Inspect the charging cable for damage
4. Remove and reseat the battery (if removable)

**Battery Draining Fast:**
1. Lower screen brightness
2. Close unused applications
3. Disable Bluetooth and WiFi when not needed
4. Check **Settings > Battery** for power-hungry apps
5. Enable Battery Saver mode

**Battery Health:**
- Batteries degrade over time (2-3 years typical)
- If holding less than 50% capacity, may need replacement

**Create a ticket** if you need a new battery or charger.

articles.title: Webcam Not Working
articles.question: My webcam isn't working in video calls
articles.content:
## Webcam Troubleshooting

**Basic Checks:**
1. Is the webcam covered? (Check privacy shutter)
2. Is another app using the camera?
3. Is the camera selected in your meeting app?

**In Windows:**
1. Go to **Settings > Privacy > Camera**
2. Ensure **Camera access** is ON
3. Allow desktop apps to access camera

**In Your Meeting App:**
1. Go to Settings > Video/Camera
2. Select the correct camera device
3. Check the preview to confirm it works

**External Webcam:**
1. Unplug and replug the USB cable
2. Try a different USB port
3. Check if drivers need updating

**For laptops:** Your built-in camera may have a function key (F8 etc.) to enable/disable it.

articles.title: Microphone or Audio Not Working
articles.question: My audio or microphone isn't working
articles.content:
## Audio Troubleshooting

**No Sound Output:**
1. Check volume isn't muted (click speaker icon)
2. Verify correct output device is selected
3. Test with different headphones/speakers
4. Run Windows audio troubleshooter

**Microphone Not Working:**
1. Check if muted in the app and Windows
2. Go to **Settings > Privacy > Microphone**
3. Ensure microphone access is enabled
4. Select correct input device in Sound settings

**In Video Calls:**
1. Check app settings for audio devices
2. Leave and rejoin the meeting
3. Try the web version of the app

**Bluetooth Audio:**
- Disconnect and reconnect
- Remove the pairing and re-pair
- Ensure device is in range

articles.title: USB Device Not Recognized
articles.question: My USB device isn't being recognized
articles.content:
## USB Device Troubleshooting

**Quick Fixes:**
1. Try a different USB port
2. Try the device on another computer
3. Restart your computer with the device plugged in

**Check Device Manager:**
1. Press **Windows + X** > Device Manager
2. Look for yellow warning icons
3. Right-click problematic device > **Update driver**
4. Or try **Uninstall device** and replug

**USB Hub Issues:**
- Try connecting directly to the computer
- Powered hubs work better for high-draw devices

**External Hard Drives:**
- May need external power
- Check if disk appears in Disk Management
- May need to be initialized or formatted

**If the device works elsewhere,** your USB port may need repair.

articles.title: Application Crashing or Freezing
articles.question: An application keeps crashing or freezing
articles.content:
## Application Crash Troubleshooting

**If the App is Frozen:**
1. Press **Ctrl + Alt + Delete** > Task Manager
2. Select the frozen app
3. Click **End Task**
4. Reopen the application

**Prevent Future Crashes:**
1. **Update the application** to the latest version
2. **Restart your computer** to clear memory
3. **Check for Windows updates**
4. **Disable conflicting add-ins/extensions**

**If It Keeps Crashing:**
1. Uninstall and reinstall the application
2. Run as Administrator (right-click > Run as admin)
3. Check for known issues on the app's support site
4. Create a support ticket with the error message

**Save your work frequently** to avoid losing data in crashes!

articles.title: Microsoft Office Issues
articles.question: Microsoft Office isn't working properly
articles.content:
## Microsoft Office Troubleshooting

**Office Not Opening:**
1. Restart your computer
2. Check for Office updates
3. Run Office repair (see below)

**Repair Office:**
1. Go to **Settings > Apps > Installed apps**
2. Find Microsoft 365
3. Click **Modify** > **Quick Repair**
4. If that doesn't work, try **Online Repair**

**Activation Issues:**
- Sign out and sign back in with your work email
- Ensure you're connected to the internet
- Contact IT if you see "Product Deactivated"

**Specific Apps:**
- **Outlook:** Recreate your profile if emails are stuck
- **Excel:** Disable add-ins if formulas are slow
- **Teams:** Clear cache in %appdata%\Microsoft\Teams

articles.title: Browser Issues
articles.question: My web browser isn't working properly
articles.content:
## Browser Troubleshooting

**Pages Not Loading:**
1. Check your internet connection
2. Try a different website
3. Try a different browser
4. Clear browser cache and cookies

**Clear Cache (Chrome/Edge):**
1. Press **Ctrl + Shift + Delete**
2. Select **All time**
3. Check Cookies and Cached images
4. Click **Clear data**

**Browser Running Slow:**
1. Close unnecessary tabs
2. Disable unused extensions
3. Update the browser
4. Reset browser settings to default

**Website-Specific Issues:**
- Try incognito/private mode
- Disable ad blockers temporarily
- Check if the site is down for everyone

**Recommended browsers:** Chrome, Edge, Firefox

articles.title: Windows Update Issues
articles.question: Windows Update isn't working or is stuck
articles.content:
## Windows Update Troubleshooting

**Update Stuck/Failed:**
1. Restart your computer and try again
2. Run Windows Update Troubleshooter:
   - **Settings > System > Troubleshoot > Other Troubleshooters**
   - Run **Windows Update**

**Low Disk Space:**
- Updates need 10+ GB free space
- Run Disk Cleanup to free space
- Empty Recycle Bin

**Repeated Restart Loop:**
1. Let it run - updates can take 30+ minutes
2. If stuck over an hour, hold power to force off
3. Boot in Safe Mode and try again

**When to Update:**
- Save all work before updating
- Update at end of day
- Plug in laptop before updating

**Create a ticket** if updates repeatedly fail.

articles.title: WiFi Connection Issues
articles.question: I can't connect to WiFi or internet isn't working
articles.content:
## WiFi Troubleshooting

**No WiFi Networks Found:**
1. Make sure WiFi is turned on (check Fn key)
2. Toggle Airplane mode off
3. Restart your computer
4. Check if others can see the network

**Connected But No Internet:**
1. Try forgetting and reconnecting to the network
2. Run Network troubleshooter
3. Restart your router (if at home)
4. Try a different network to isolate the issue

**Slow WiFi:**
1. Move closer to the router
2. Reduce interference (microwaves, other devices)
3. Connect to 5GHz network if available
4. Try a wired connection for better speed

**In the Office:**
- Connect to the corporate network (not guest)
- VPN may be required for some resources

articles.title: Network Drive or Shared Folder Issues
articles.question: I can't access a network drive or shared folder
articles.content:
## Network Drive Troubleshooting

**Can't Find the Drive:**
1. Check you're connected to the network/VPN
2. Open File Explorer and click **Network**
3. Try mapping the drive manually:
   - Right-click **This PC** > **Map network drive**
   - Enter the path (e.g., \\\server\share)

**Access Denied:**
1. Verify you have permission to access the folder
2. Try logging out and back into Windows
3. Contact the folder owner to grant access

**Drive Disappears After Restart:**
1. When mapping, check **Reconnect at sign-in**
2. Ensure you're on the same network
3. Use Group Policy mapped drives if available

**Slow File Access:**
- Large files are slow over VPN
- Consider syncing files locally with OneDrive

articles.title: Internet is Slow
articles.question: Why is my internet so slow?
articles.content:
## Slow Internet Troubleshooting

**Test Your Speed:**
1. Go to speedtest.net
2. Run a test
3. Compare to your expected speed

**Quick Fixes:**
1. Restart your router/modem (unplug 30 seconds)
2. Connect via ethernet instead of WiFi
3. Move closer to your WiFi router
4. Close bandwidth-heavy applications

**At Home:**
- Check if others are streaming/downloading
- Consider upgrading your internet plan
- Position router centrally, away from walls

**At Office:**
- Connect to 5GHz WiFi if available
- Avoid peak usage times
- Report consistently slow speeds to IT

**VPN Considerations:**
- VPN typically reduces speed by 10-30%
- Try a closer VPN server
- Disconnect VPN for non-work browsing

video.title: Troubleshooting Slow Internet - IP & DNS Configurations

articles.title: Bluetooth Not Working
articles.question: Bluetooth isn't working or won't pair
articles.content:
## Bluetooth Troubleshooting

**Enable Bluetooth:**
1. Press **Windows + A** for Action Center
2. Click **Bluetooth** to turn it on
3. Or: Settings > Bluetooth & devices

**Pairing a Device:**
1. Put your device in pairing mode (check manual)
2. Go to **Settings > Bluetooth & devices**
3. Click **Add device** > **Bluetooth**
4. Select your device from the list

**Device Won't Connect:**
1. Remove the device and re-pair it
2. Restart both the device and computer
3. Check device battery level
4. Move devices closer together

**No Bluetooth Option:**
- Check if your PC has Bluetooth
- Update Bluetooth drivers
- Enable Bluetooth adapter in Device Manager

**Audio devices:** Also check Windows sound settings for correct output.

articles.title: File Recovery - Deleted Files
articles.question: I accidentally deleted an important file
articles.content:
## File Recovery Options

**Check Recycle Bin First:**
1. Open **Recycle Bin** on desktop
2. Find your file
3. Right-click > **Restore**

**OneDrive/SharePoint:**
1. Go to OneDrive.com
2. Click **Recycle bin** in the left panel
3. Files kept for 93 days
4. Select and click **Restore**

**Previous Versions:**
1. Right-click the folder where the file was
2. Click **Properties** > **Previous Versions**
3. Select a version before deletion
4. Click **Restore**

**Network Drives:**
- IT maintains backups of shared drives
- Create a ticket with file name and approximate date

⚠️ **Act quickly!** The longer you wait, the harder recovery becomes.

video.title: File Restoration Techniques - Recycle Bin & Backup Recovery

articles.title: How to Take a Screenshot
articles.question: How do I take a screenshot?
articles.content:
## Screenshot Methods

**Full Screen:**
- Press **Print Screen (PrtSc)** key
- Image is copied to clipboard
- Paste with Ctrl+V into any app

**Save to File:**
- Press **Windows + Print Screen**
- Saves to Pictures > Screenshots folder

**Snipping Tool (Recommended):**
- Press **Windows + Shift + S**
- Select the area to capture
- Opens in Snipping Tool for editing
- Click **Copy** or **Save**

**Active Window Only:**
- Press **Alt + Print Screen**
- Captures just the current window

**Video Recording:**
- Press **Windows + G** for Game Bar
- Click record button
- Great for capturing steps to reproduce issues

articles.title: Docking Station Issues
articles.question: My docking station isn't working properly
articles.content:
## Docking Station Troubleshooting

**No Display on Monitors:**
1. Check all cable connections (dock to laptop, dock to monitors)
2. Press **Windows + P** and select **Extend**
3. Try connecting monitor directly to laptop

**Dock Not Recognized:**
1. Unplug dock from laptop and replug
2. Try a different USB-C/Thunderbolt port
3. Restart laptop while docked
4. Update dock firmware (check manufacturer site)

**Devices Not Working Through Dock:**
1. USB ports may have limited power
2. Try connecting devices directly to laptop
3. Use powered USB hub for high-draw devices

**Power Issues:**
- Ensure dock's power adapter is connected
- Some docks can't charge while powered off

**Create a ticket** if you need dock drivers or firmware updates.

articles.title: Computer Won't Turn On
articles.question: My computer won't turn on at all
articles.content:
## Computer Won't Start

**Check Power:**
1. Is it plugged in? (Check both ends)
2. Try a different outlet
3. Check power strip is on
4. Try a different power cable if available

**Laptop Specific:**
1. Hold power button for 10 seconds
2. Unplug charger, remove battery if possible
3. Hold power 30 seconds to drain residual power
4. Reconnect and try again

**Signs of Life?**
- **Fans spin but no display:** See monitor troubleshooting
- **Beeping sounds:** Hardware issue - create ticket
- **Lights flash then off:** Power supply issue

**Desktop Computers:**
- Check the power switch on the back
- Ensure all internal cables are seated

**Create an urgent ticket** if the computer contains critical work data.

video.title: Computer Won't Start - Basic Power & Reset Checks

articles.title: Blue Screen Error (BSOD)
articles.question: I keep getting a blue screen error
articles.content:
## Blue Screen (BSOD) Troubleshooting

**When It Happens:**
1. Note the **STOP code** if visible (e.g., KERNEL_DATA_INPAGE_ERROR)
2. Let the computer restart normally
3. If it works, continue using but monitor

**Common Causes:**
- Bad driver update
- Hardware failure (RAM, hard drive)
- Overheating
- Windows corruption

**If It Keeps Happening:**
1. Update Windows and drivers
2. Run **sfc /scannow** in Command Prompt (admin)
3. Check for overheating (clean vents)
4. Run memory diagnostic (Windows Memory Diagnostic)

**In a Restart Loop:**
1. Boot into Safe Mode (hold Shift during restart)
2. Uninstall recent driver/software updates
3. Run System Restore

**Create a ticket** with the STOP code for assistance.

video.title: Blue Screen of Death (BSOD) - Causes & Troubleshooting

articles.title: OneDrive Sync Issues
articles.question: OneDrive isn't syncing my files
articles.content:
## OneDrive Sync Troubleshooting

**Check Sync Status:**
1. Click OneDrive icon in system tray
2. Look for sync status/errors
3. Hover over files to see individual status

**Common Fixes:**
1. **Pause and resume sync** (right-click OneDrive icon)
2. **Check internet connection**
3. **Restart OneDrive** (Close and reopen from Start menu)
4. **Check storage quota** (may be full)

**Sync Conflicts:**
- Files with conflicts show with your name appended
- Review both versions and keep the correct one
- Delete the duplicate

**Files Stuck "Pending":**
1. File name may contain invalid characters
2. File path may be too long
3. File may be open in another app

**Reset OneDrive** (last resort):
- Run: %localappdata%\Microsoft\OneDrive\onedrive.exe /reset

articles.title: Request New Hardware
articles.question: How do I request new hardware or a computer upgrade?
articles.content:
## Hardware Request Process

**Standard Equipment:**
- Laptops, monitors, keyboards, mice
- Request through IT ticketing system
- Requires manager approval for items over $200

**Create a Request:**
1. Submit a support ticket
2. Include:
   - What you need
   - Business justification
   - Urgency level
   - Your manager's name

**Replacement Criteria:**
- Computers are replaced every 3-4 years
- Or if repair cost exceeds 50% of replacement
- Performance issues affecting productivity

**Timeline:**
- Standard requests: 1-2 weeks
- Urgent requests: 3-5 business days
- New hire equipment: Ordered upon HR notification

**Note:** All company equipment remains property of the company and must be returned upon departure.

articles.title: Security Alert - Phishing or Suspicious Email
articles.question: I received a suspicious email or think I've been phished
articles.content:
## Handling Suspicious Emails

**Signs of Phishing:**
- Unexpected sender or "from" address doesn't match
- Urgent language ("Act now!" "Account suspended!")
- Requests for passwords or personal info
- Suspicious links (hover to check URL)
- Spelling/grammar errors

**If You Haven't Clicked:**
1. **Don't click any links or attachments**
2. Report it: Click **Report** in your email client
3. Delete the email
4. Block the sender if spam

**If You Clicked a Link or Entered Credentials:**
1. **Immediately change your password**
2. Enable 2FA if not already on
3. Report to IT Security immediately
4. Monitor your accounts for suspicious activity

**When in Doubt:**
- Forward suspicious emails to security@company.com
- Call IT to verify legitimacy
- Never share passwords via email

video.title: Malware Handling - Network Isolation & Safe Removal

articles.title: Computer Overheating
articles.question: My computer is overheating or fans are very loud
articles.content:
## Overheating Troubleshooting

**Signs of Overheating:**
- Fans running constantly at high speed
- Computer feels hot to touch
- Sudden shutdowns or performance slowdown

**Quick Fixes:**
1. **Ensure proper ventilation** - Don't block air vents
2. **Clean dust buildup** - Use compressed air on vents
3. **Use on hard surface** - Not on beds or carpets
4. **Use a laptop cooling pad**

**Check Running Processes:**
1. Open Task Manager (Ctrl+Shift+Esc)
2. Check CPU/GPU usage
3. End unnecessary high-usage processes

**Environmental Factors:**
- Keep room temperature reasonable
- Avoid direct sunlight on computer
- Ensure adequate desk space around computer

**If overheating persists**, thermal paste may need replacement - create a ticket.

articles.title: Low Disk Space
articles.question: I'm getting low disk space warnings
articles.content:
## Freeing Up Disk Space

**Check Current Usage:**
1. Go to **Settings > System > Storage**
2. See what's using space

**Quick Cleanup:**
1. **Empty Recycle Bin** - Right-click > Empty
2. **Run Disk Cleanup** - Search "Disk Cleanup" in Start
3. **Clear Downloads folder** - Delete old files
4. **Clear browser cache** - Can recover several GB

**OneDrive Files On-Demand:**
1. Right-click OneDrive files > **Free up space**
2. Files remain accessible but stored in cloud

**Uninstall Unused Programs:**
- Go to **Settings > Apps > Installed apps**
- Remove programs you don't use

**Move Large Files:**
- Move videos/photos to external drive or cloud
- Archive old projects

**Recommended:** Keep at least 10-15GB free for Windows updates.

articles.title: Scanner Not Working
articles.question: My scanner isn't working
articles.content:
## Scanner Troubleshooting

**Basic Checks:**
1. Is the scanner powered on?
2. Is it connected (USB or network)?
3. Is the glass/feeder clear of obstructions?

**Software Setup:**
1. Open **Windows Fax and Scan** or manufacturer software
2. Select correct scanner device
3. Try scanning a test document

**If Not Detected:**
1. Unplug and replug USB cable
2. Try a different USB port
3. Check Device Manager for issues
4. Reinstall scanner drivers

**Network Scanners:**
- Ensure you're on the same network
- Check scanner IP address hasn't changed
- Re-add scanner using IP address

**Quality Issues:**
- Clean scanner glass with soft cloth
- Adjust resolution settings
- Check original document quality

articles.title: Projector Not Displaying
articles.question: The projector isn't showing my screen
articles.content:
## Projector Troubleshooting

**Quick Fixes:**
1. Press **Windows + P** > Select **Duplicate** or **Extend**
2. Check cable connection at both ends
3. Ensure projector is on correct input source

**Common Issues:**
1. **Wrong input selected** - Use projector remote to cycle inputs
2. **Cable not seated** - Disconnect and reconnect firmly
3. **Resolution mismatch** - Lower your display resolution

**If Using HDMI:**
- Try a different HDMI cable
- Check if adapter is needed (USB-C to HDMI)
- Some laptops need Thunderbolt adapter

**If Using Wireless:**
- Connect to meeting room WiFi
- Use screen sharing feature
- Check if firewall is blocking

**For Presentations:**
- Test connection before meeting starts
- Have backup plan (share screen via Teams/Zoom)

articles.title: Slow VPN Connection
articles.question: My VPN connection is very slow
articles.content:
## Improving VPN Speed

**Understanding VPN Speed:**
- VPN typically reduces speed by 10-30%
- Encryption adds overhead
- Distance to server matters

**Quick Fixes:**
1. **Try a different VPN server** - Choose geographically closer
2. **Restart VPN client** - Reconnect fresh
3. **Check base internet speed** - Test without VPN first

**Optimize Your Connection:**
1. Use wired ethernet instead of WiFi
2. Close bandwidth-heavy apps (streaming, downloads)
3. Disconnect other devices from your network

**Split Tunneling:**
- If available, route only work traffic through VPN
- Personal browsing goes direct
- Ask IT if this option exists

**Peak Usage:**
- Try off-peak hours if possible
- Early morning often faster than mid-day

**Create a ticket** if speed is consistently unusable.

articles.title: Printing Format Issues
articles.question: My documents are printing in the wrong format or size
articles.content:
## Print Format Troubleshooting

**Check Paper Size:**
1. Go to **File > Print > Properties**
2. Verify paper size matches loaded paper
3. Common sizes: Letter (8.5x11), A4, Legal

**Wrong Margins:**
1. Check document's page setup
2. Adjust margins in print settings
3. Use "Fit to Page" option if available

**Color vs Black and White:**
- Check print settings for color option
- Some printers default to grayscale
- May need to select correct printer

**Scaling Issues:**
1. Look for "Scale" or "Fit" options
2. Set to 100% for actual size
3. Use "Actual Size" not "Shrink to Fit"

**Printer Tray Settings:**
- Correct tray may not be selected
- Check tray contains correct paper size
- Some printers have manual feed option

articles.title: Software Won't Run or Start
articles.question: A software application won't start or run
articles.content:
## Application Won't Start

**Basic Fixes:**
1. **Restart your computer** - Clears memory issues
2. **Run as Administrator** - Right-click > Run as admin
3. **Check if already running** - Look in Task Manager

**Compatibility Issues:**
1. Right-click app > Properties > Compatibility
2. Try compatibility mode for older Windows
3. Check if 32-bit app needs 32-bit mode

**Reinstall Application:**
1. Uninstall completely from Settings > Apps
2. Restart computer
3. Download fresh installer
4. Reinstall with admin rights

**Check Dependencies:**
- Some apps need .NET Framework
- Some need Visual C++ Redistributables
- Install required components

**If Recently Updated:**
- Recent update may have broken the app
- Check for further updates or patches
- Roll back to previous version if available

articles.title: Lost or Stolen Device
articles.question: My laptop or device has been lost or stolen
articles.content:
## Lost/Stolen Device Procedure

⚠️ **Act Immediately!**

**Step 1: Report to IT**
1. Call IT Security hotline immediately
2. Provide device serial number if known
3. Note last known location and time

**Step 2: Change Passwords**
1. Change your main account password
2. Change any passwords stored on device
3. Enable 2FA on all accounts

**Step 3: Remote Actions (IT Will Help)**
- Locate device if online
- Remote lock the device
- Remote wipe if necessary

**Step 4: Report Theft**
- File police report if stolen
- Provide report number to IT
- Check if visible on "Find My Device"

**Prevention Tips:**
- Never leave devices unattended
- Use strong lock screen PIN
- Enable encryption
- Don't store passwords in browser on shared devices

articles.title: Remote Desktop Connection Issues
articles.question: I can't connect to remote desktop
articles.content:
## Remote Desktop Troubleshooting

**Prerequisites:**
- VPN must be connected first
- Target computer must be powered on
- Remote Desktop must be enabled on target

**Connection Steps:**
1. Connect to VPN
2. Open **Remote Desktop Connection**
3. Enter computer name or IP address
4. Enter your credentials

**Common Issues:**

**Can't Find Computer:**
- Verify computer name is correct
- Try IP address instead of name
- Check with IT for correct address

**Connection Refused:**
- Target PC may be off or sleeping
- Firewall may be blocking
- Another user may be logged in

**Slow Performance:**
- Lower display quality in RDP settings
- Disable visual effects
- Use faster VPN server

articles.title: Windows Taskbar Not Responding
articles.question: The Windows taskbar or Start menu isn't responding
articles.content:
## Taskbar Troubleshooting

**Quick Fix - Restart Explorer:**
1. Press **Ctrl + Shift + Esc** to open Task Manager
2. Find **Windows Explorer** in the list
3. Right-click > **Restart**

**If Task Manager Won't Open:**
1. Press **Ctrl + Alt + Delete**
2. Select Task Manager from menu

**Clear Taskbar Cache:**
1. Open File Explorer
2. Navigate to: %LocalAppData%\Packages\Microsoft.Windows.ShellExperienceHost_cw5n1h2txyewy\TempState
3. Delete contents
4. Restart computer

**System File Check:**
1. Open Command Prompt as Admin
2. Run: **sfc /scannow**
3. Let it complete and restart

**If Problem Persists:**
- Check for Windows updates
- Create new user profile (test)
- May need system restore

articles.title: Microsoft Store Not Working
articles.question: The Microsoft Store won't open or download apps
articles.content:
## Microsoft Store Troubleshooting

**Reset Store Cache:**
1. Press **Windows + R**
2. Type **wsreset.exe** and press Enter
3. Wait for Store to open

**Run Store Troubleshooter:**
1. Go to **Settings > System > Troubleshoot**
2. Select **Other troubleshooters**
3. Run **Windows Store Apps**

**Check Account:**
1. Open Store > Click profile icon
2. Sign out and sign back in
3. Ensure using correct account

**Downloads Stuck:**
1. Cancel pending downloads
2. Go to Downloads queue
3. Clear and retry

**Re-register Store:**
1. Open PowerShell as Admin
2. Run: **Get-AppXPackage *WindowsStore* | Foreach {Add-AppxPackage -DisableDevelopmentMode -Register "$($_.InstallLocation)\AppXManifest.xml"}**

**Note:** Some company policies may restrict Store downloads.

articles.title: Sleep Mode Issues
articles.question: My computer won't go to sleep or won't wake up
articles.content:
## Sleep Mode Troubleshooting

**Won't Enter Sleep:**
1. Check **Settings > System > Power & battery**
2. Verify sleep timer is set
3. Check what's preventing sleep:
   - Open Command Prompt as Admin
   - Run: **powercfg /requests**

**Common Blockers:**
- Media players running
- Downloads in progress
- Scheduled tasks
- Peripheral devices (mouse sensitivity)

**Won't Wake Up:**
1. Try pressing any key or moving mouse
2. Press power button briefly (not hold)
3. Check if keyboard can wake PC:
   - Device Manager > Keyboards > Properties
   - Power Management > Allow to wake

**Black Screen After Wake:**
1. Update graphics drivers
2. Disable Fast Startup
3. Check monitor cable connection

**Disable Problematic Settings:**
- Settings > Power > Disable hybrid sleep
- May need to disable Fast Startup

articles.title: Ethernet Cable Not Working
articles.question: My ethernet cable isn't working
articles.content:
## Ethernet Troubleshooting

**Check Physical Connection:**
1. Ensure cable clicks into port on both ends
2. Check for damaged cable ends
3. Look for link lights on port and router

**Try Different Cable:**
- Cables can fail internally
- Try a known working cable
- Cat5e or Cat6 recommended

**Try Different Port:**
- Router/switch port may be dead
- Try another port on the router
- Try different port on PC if available

**Reset Network Adapter:**
1. Open Settings > Network & internet
2. Click Advanced network settings
3. Network reset > Reset now

**Update/Reinstall Driver:**
1. Open Device Manager
2. Find Network adapters
3. Right-click ethernet adapter > Update driver
4. Or Uninstall and restart PC

**Check for IP Address:**
- Open Command Prompt
- Run: **ipconfig**
- Should show IP like 192.168.x.x

articles.title: Pop-ups and Adware
articles.question: I'm getting unwanted pop-ups or ads everywhere
articles.content:
## Removing Pop-ups and Adware

**Browser Extensions:**
1. Open browser settings > Extensions
2. Remove any you don't recognize
3. Remove recently installed extensions

**Reset Browser:**
- **Chrome:** Settings > Reset settings > Restore to defaults
- **Edge:** Settings > Reset settings > Restore to defaults
- **Firefox:** Help > More troubleshooting > Refresh Firefox

**Check Installed Programs:**
1. Go to Settings > Apps > Installed apps
2. Sort by install date
3. Remove suspicious or unfamiliar programs

**Run Malware Scan:**
1. Use Windows Security scan
2. Download Malwarebytes (free) for second opinion
3. Run full system scan

**Check Browser Homepage:**
- Ensure it's set to what you want
- Check default search engine

**Prevention:**
- Use ad blocker extension (uBlock Origin)
- Be careful what you download
- Don't click suspicious ads

articles.title: Ransomware Attack
articles.question: My files are encrypted and I'm being asked to pay
articles.content:
## Ransomware Response

⚠️ **CRITICAL - ACT IMMEDIATELY**

**Step 1: STOP**
1. **DO NOT PAY THE RANSOM**
2. Disconnect from network (unplug ethernet, disable WiFi)
3. Do not turn off the computer yet

**Step 2: Report to IT**
1. Call IT Security hotline immediately
2. Report incident to your manager
3. Take photos of ransom message

**Step 3: Contain Spread**
- Disconnect any shared drives
- Warn colleagues not to open suspicious emails
- IT will isolate affected systems

**What IT Will Do:**
- Investigate infection source
- Check backup availability
- Attempt decryption if possible
- Restore from clean backups

**Recovery:**
- Restore files from latest backup
- Some ransomware has free decryption tools
- Check NoMoreRansom.org for decryptors

**Prevention:** Regular backups, email vigilance, keep software updated.

articles.title: Antivirus Issues
articles.question: My antivirus isn't working or updating
articles.content:
## Antivirus Troubleshooting

**Check Windows Security:**
1. Open Windows Security from Start menu
2. Check all sections show green checkmarks
3. If yellow/red, click to see issue

**Manually Update Definitions:**
1. Open Windows Security
2. Virus & threat protection
3. Click Protection updates > Check for updates

**If Won't Update:**
1. Check internet connection
2. Run Windows Update first
3. Restart computer and try again

**Real-Time Protection Off:**
1. May be disabled by group policy (normal in enterprise)
2. If you can enable it, do so
3. Contact IT if you can't enable and it should be on

**Scanning Issues:**
- Full scan takes hours - schedule overnight
- Quick scan for immediate checks
- Exclude false positives in settings

**Multiple AV Problem:**
- Don't install multiple antivirus programs
- They conflict and slow the system
- Use Windows Security + one other at most

articles.title: Too Many Startup Programs
articles.question: Too many programs start when I turn on my computer
articles.content:
## Managing Startup Programs

**Disable Startup Apps:**
1. Right-click taskbar > Task Manager
2. Go to **Startup apps** tab
3. Right-click unnecessary apps > **Disable**

**What to Disable:**
- Third-party updaters (Adobe, Java)
- Rarely used programs
- Programs you can open manually
- Toolbars and utilities

**What to Keep Enabled:**
- Security software (antivirus)
- VPN if always needed
- Cloud sync (OneDrive) if you use it
- Essential work applications

**Check Impact:**
- Task Manager shows startup impact
- Focus on "High" impact items
- "Low" impact items less important

**Hidden Startup Items:**
1. Open Settings > Apps > Startup
2. Review all items
3. Toggle off what's not needed

**Result:** Faster boot times and improved performance.

articles.title: Windows Activation Issues
articles.question: Windows says it's not activated
articles.content:
## Windows Activation

**Check Activation Status:**
1. Go to Settings > System > Activation
2. See current activation status

**Common Messages:**
- **"Activate Windows"** watermark on desktop
- **"Windows not activated"** in settings

**For Company Computers:**
- Contact IT - this should be automatic
- May need to connect to company network
- VPN connection may trigger activation

**Run Activation Troubleshooter:**
1. Settings > System > Activation
2. Click Troubleshoot
3. Follow prompts

**After Hardware Change:**
- Activation may deactivate after major hardware changes
- Use digital license linked to Microsoft account
- Contact IT for re-activation

⚠️ **Never use third-party activation tools** - they contain malware.

**Legitimate Activation:**
- Company handles all licensing
- Create ticket if activation fails

articles.title: Firewall Blocking Application
articles.question: The firewall is blocking an application I need
articles.content:
## Firewall Configuration

**Check if Firewall is Blocking:**
1. Try disabling firewall temporarily (test only)
2. If app works, firewall is the issue
3. Re-enable firewall immediately

**Allow an App Through Firewall:**
1. Open Windows Security
2. Firewall & network protection
3. Allow an app through firewall
4. Click Change settings
5. Find app or click "Allow another app"
6. Add the application

**For Specific Ports:**
1. Open Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security
2. Inbound Rules > New Rule
3. Select Port
4. Enter port number
5. Allow connection

⚠️ **Company Restrictions:**
- IT may manage firewall centrally
- Some apps may be blocked by policy
- Create a ticket if you need access

**Don't disable firewall permanently** - it protects your computer.

articles.title: Mobile Data Not Working
articles.question: My phone's mobile data isn't working
articles.content:
## Mobile Data Troubleshooting

**Quick Checks:**
1. Is mobile data turned on? Check quick settings
2. Is Airplane mode off?
3. Do you have signal bars?

**Toggle Data:**
1. Turn off mobile data
2. Wait 10 seconds
3. Turn it back on

**Restart Phone:**
- Turn phone off completely
- Wait 30 seconds
- Turn back on

**Check APN Settings:**
- Settings > Mobile Network > Access Point Names
- Select your carrier's default APN
- Reset to default if unsure

**SIM Card Issues:**
1. Turn off phone
2. Remove and reinsert SIM card
3. Ensure SIM is seated properly
4. Turn phone back on

**Account Issues:**
- Check if data plan is active
- Contact carrier if data limit reached
- Roaming may need to be enabled abroad

**For Work Phones:** Contact IT for carrier issues.

articles.title: App Won't Install on Phone
articles.question: I can't install an app on my phone
articles.content:
## App Installation Issues

**Check Storage Space:**
- Go to Settings > Storage
- Clear space if low
- Delete old apps, photos, cache

**Check Internet Connection:**
- Try WiFi instead of mobile data
- Download may need strong connection
- Large apps need WiFi often

**App Store Issues:**

**Android (Play Store):**
1. Clear Play Store cache
2. Settings > Apps > Play Store > Clear cache
3. Force stop and reopen

**iPhone (App Store):**
1. Sign out and back into App Store
2. Settings > [Your name] > Sign out
3. Restart phone

**Update Pending:**
- Install pending updates first
- Some apps need latest OS version

**Work Phone Restrictions:**
- MDM may block certain apps
- Only approved apps may be installable
- Contact IT for app requests

articles.title: Smartphone Battery Draining Fast
articles.question: My smartphone battery is draining too quickly
articles.content:
## Phone Battery Optimization

**Quick Fixes:**
1. Lower screen brightness
2. Turn off WiFi/Bluetooth when not needed
3. Close background apps
4. Enable battery saver mode

**Check Battery Usage:**
- Settings > Battery > Battery usage
- See which apps drain most
- Restrict or uninstall battery hogs

**Location Services:**
- Turn off location for apps that don't need it
- Use "While using" instead of "Always"

**Push Notifications:**
- Reduce notification frequency
- Disable for non-essential apps

**Screen Settings:**
- Lower screen timeout
- Use dark mode (OLED screens)
- Disable always-on display

**App Background Refresh:**
- Disable for apps that don't need it
- Settings > Apps > Background restrictions

**Battery Health:**
- Batteries degrade over time
- After 2 years, capacity drops significantly
- Consider battery replacement

articles.title: Microsoft Teams Issues
articles.question: Microsoft Teams isn't working properly
articles.content:
## Microsoft Teams Troubleshooting

**Teams Not Opening:**
1. Close Teams completely from system tray
2. Clear Teams cache:
   - Close Teams
   - Delete: %appdata%\Microsoft\Teams\Cache
   - Restart Teams

**Can't Join Meetings:**
1. Check internet connection
2. Try joining via web browser instead
3. Sign out and back into Teams

**Audio/Video Issues:**
1. Check device settings in Teams
2. Settings > Devices
3. Test microphone and camera
4. Check Windows privacy settings

**Screen Sharing Not Working:**
1. Close and rejoin meeting
2. Check if presenter rights granted
3. Try sharing specific window vs full screen

**Teams Running Slow:**
1. Clear cache as above
2. Disable GPU hardware acceleration
3. Update to latest version

**For Persistent Issues:**
- Uninstall and reinstall Teams
- Try Teams web at teams.microsoft.com
- Create a support ticket

articles.title: Zoom Meeting Issues
articles.question: I'm having problems with Zoom meetings
articles.content:
## Zoom Troubleshooting

**Can't Join Meeting:**
1. Check meeting ID and password
2. Update Zoom to latest version
3. Try joining via web browser
4. Check if host has started the meeting

**Audio Not Working:**
1. Click Audio settings in meeting
2. Test speaker and microphone
3. Select correct devices
4. Join with Computer Audio (not Phone Call)

**Video Not Working:**
1. Click Video settings
2. Check camera is selected
3. Ensure Zoom has camera permission
4. Check if camera shutter is closed

**Screen Sharing Issues:**
1. Host must enable screen sharing for participants
2. Try Share Screen > Advanced > Portion of Screen
3. Close other apps to reduce load

**Connection Problems:**
1. Test internet speed
2. Disable virtual backgrounds if slow
3. Close other bandwidth-heavy apps
4. Try audio only if video lags

**For Company Zoom:** Contact IT for account issues.

articles.title: Slow Boot Time
articles.question: My computer takes a long time to start up
articles.content:
## Improving Boot Time

**Reduce Startup Programs:**
1. Task Manager > Startup apps
2. Disable unnecessary programs
3. Focus on high-impact items

**Enable Fast Startup:**
1. Control Panel > Power Options
2. Choose what power buttons do
3. Change settings currently unavailable
4. Check "Turn on fast startup"

**Check for Malware:**
- Run full antivirus scan
- Malware can slow startup significantly

**Disk Health:**
1. Open Command Prompt as Admin
2. Run: **chkdsk C: /f**
3. Restart to run disk check
4. Consider SSD upgrade if using HDD

**Windows Updates:**
- Updates may run at startup
- Let updates complete
- Restart multiple times if needed

**BIOS Settings:**
- Disable unused boot devices
- Enable SSD optimization
- Contact IT for BIOS changes

**If Very Slow:** May need system refresh or reimaging - create ticket.
